description: Implementation of a thread synchronization primitive 'ConditionVariable' for the starboard platform, including creation, destruction, waiting (with timeout), broadcast, and signal functionalities.

classes.name: ConditionVariable
classes.description: A condition variable class providing thread synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: ConditionVariable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition variable with an associated mutex.

methods.name: ~ConditionVariable
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the condition variable.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits indefinitely for the condition variable to be signaled.

methods.name: WaitTimed
methods.description: Waits for the condition variable to be signaled or timeout.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Wakes all threads waiting on the condition variable.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Wakes one thread waiting on the condition variable.
